QuestInfo.name: Preparing for the Extreme
QuestInfo.0: #bCategory: Resurrection of Rex the Hoblin King - Escort, Party Quest#k\r Type: Optional Quest\r\nContent: #bRobeira#k says that she has something to tell you before you leave to prevent the resurrection of Rex the Hoblin King.
QuestInfo.1: Make a special item passed down by thieves that can help keep you warm in the extreme cold of the Ice Ravine. Take #b10 #t4032651:#s, 1 #t4011001:#, and 1 #t2022000:##k to #bArec#k. You can obtain #t4032651:# from the monsters inside the abandoned mine.
QuestInfo.2: You put your hand in the #b#t4032650:##k to keep warm.

0.0: So, you're going to reseal Rex. I must warn you, the place you're headed is extremely cold. Just standing still will deplete your HP. The cold might even interfere with potions... I suggest you prepare yourself before you head out.

yes.0: Gather some items for #bArec#k, and he'll make you a special item passed down amongst Thieves that should keep your warm. He'll need #b10 #t4032651:#s, 1 #t4011001:#, and 1 #t2022000:##k. You can obtain #t4032651#s from the monsters in the Abandoned Mine.

no.0: You may end of freezing to death if you go unprepared.

1.1: Just thinking about the Ice Ravine makes me shiver. I'm surprised #bRobeira#k remembered that I can make this. It's made using a secret method passed down by Thieves in the El Nath region. Have you brought the required materials?

yes.0: Yes, these are it. Here goes nothing...

npc.0: Gather all the materials I told you about and go to #bArec#k, the Thief Job Instructor.

item.0: I don't think you've brought all the necessary materials. The materials are #b10 #t4032651:#s, 1 #t4011001:#, and 1 #t2022000:##k.
